content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I'm having trouble establishing communication between [product_name] and KNX using the [product_name] gateway from [company_name]. When I enter the gateway's IP in the browser, I encounter two errors: DEVICE STATUS ------> ERROR (5) [product_name] CONNECTION STATUS -------> ERROR (3) KNX CONNECTION STATUS -----------> CONNECTED (1) Also, when I try to update the firmware via "AFIRMWARE-UPDATE," I can't find the file on [company_name]'s official pages. If anyone can share this file or provide a download link, I believe I could complete the KNX - [product_name] connection. I've read on some forums that the issue with [product_name] gateway is a network problem between the gateway and [product_name]. Apparently, the device disconnects from the network after a couple of hours. There isn't a firmware update for [product_name] gateway from [company_name] yet, but you can deal with it by connecting the gateway directly to [product_name]. Placing both devices in a separate VLAN also works. If someone could advise on a solution, it would be appreciated. Best regards.
This is an English-language forum. Please use English for your posts.
What can I do to make the gateway work?

Hello [user_name], Welcome! Kindly discuss your question in English since this is an international community. Posting in English will help others respond to you. Here's the translation of your question. Regards, [user_name] (moderator)
Try enabling Dynamic Server IP Filter and set it to accept all connection requests. That should resolve your issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing recurring communication problems between [product_name] and KNX through the [product_name] gateway from [company_name], including connection errors and inaccessibility of necessary firmware updates. The user notes network instability and lack of available troubleshooting support. Direct connection or isolating devices in a VLAN provides temporary solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and consistent interaction between [product_name] and KNX using the [product_name] gateway, accessible firmware updates, and straightforward troubleshooting support. They hope for official assistance and working downloads from [company_name]'s website.
